identity.title: Retain Filter Tool Partial after concrete owner audit

origin.summary: The user requested that Partial refactoring continue in scheduled cycles and that each remaining Partial be structurally reviewed rather than mechanically deleted or split.

state.current_summary: FilterToolWpfView.xaml.cs의 no-change 구조 감사가 완료되었다. View Partial은 required XAML/custom-tool adapter로 유지되고, interaction/kernel/text/guide/shared single-input runtime/factory/document/registry/base가 editor state, presentation, preview, binding, persistence/routing, creation, and lifetime을 각각 소유한다. 독립 seam이 없어 production split은 만들지 않았으며, focused source/build/WPF/monitor and documentation evidence가 통과했다.

objective.summary: Audit FilterToolWpfView's Partial structure and retain it only if existing concrete owners already provide editor, preview, persistence, binding, routing, and lifetime boundaries without a new split.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; do not modify C:\Git\2D\Original.
Do not add a service, interface, manager, wrapper, forwarding Partial, or ViewModel split for file length alone.
Preserve FilterToolWpfView XAML names, Learn contract, layer/preview/Add Pipeline facades, settings persistence, and DisposeView lifetime.
Keep test outputs and evidence under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not commit, push, tag, release, deploy, or mutate the Original repository.

criteria.text: The proof report records current/intended owners, caller path, mutable-state writer, lifetime owner, binding/public/test contract, shortest reading order, and the reason no production split is justified.

The source contract proves that the View Partial has no direct persistence/file-dialog/algorithm coupling and that existing interaction, kernel, text/guide, single-input runtime, factory/document, registry, and base lifetime owners are wired.
Focused Debug/Release contracts and builds plus Filter WPF smoke and dynamic monitor geometry pass; broader theme/DPI/input/camera/SDK/GPU/native runtime remains explicitly unverified.

artifacts.summary: Fresh Filter/Morphology layout guard WPF smoke screenshot.
Dynamic monitor/window geometry for the Filter smoke.

evidence.observation: FilterToolWpfView remains a required XAML/custom-tool adapter. Existing interaction, kernel, text, guide, presenter/ViewModel, shared single-input runtime, factory/document, registry, and base owners provide concrete editor, presentation, preview, binding, persistence/routing, creation, and lifetime boundaries. The View has no direct settings store, dialog, System.IO, OpenCvSharp, or algorithm construction coupling.
FilterToolPartialBoundaryContract passed 9/9 in Debug and Release. VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug and Release builds passed with 0 warnings/errors.
Filter-focused WPF smoke and dynamic monitor/window probing are recorded here; broader UI and native matrices remain unverified.

RunUiPrecheck passed wpf_filter_morphology_layout_guard and wpf_openvision_learn_filtering with check=OK, layout/text/internal counts zero, and fresh PNGs. Dynamic monitor probing recorded DISPLAY2 1920x1080 with one visible intersecting smoke window. Broader UI and native matrices remain unverified.

events.summary: FilterToolWpfView Partial은 required XAML/custom-tool adapter이며, Filter interaction/kernel/text/guide, presenter/ViewModel, shared single-input runtime, factory/document, registry/base owners가 독립 책임과 lifetime을 이미 제공한다. 새 seam 없이 분리하면 forwarding wrapper나 중복 상태가 되므로 no-change로 유지한다.

PL-0045의 세 completion criteria가 현재 source, contract, build, WPF smoke, monitor, and documentation evidence로 충족되어 resolved로 닫는다. 전체 theme/DPI/input, native dialog, camera/SDK/GPU 및 long-running native runtime은 이 slice의 검증 범위가 아니다.

The Filter Tool Partial retained-owner audit found no independent boundary that justified a production split; focused source/build/WPF/monitor/documentation evidence was recorded. Do not reopen without a new requirement, reproducible defect, failed criterion, or changed dependency/lifetime boundary.
